topic: Myth: My teen needs to focus only on school
caption:
School matters. So does knowing how the real world works.
Teens who earn their own money learn to manage time better, not worse.
A small weekend hustle won't hurt their GPA. It might actually help their focus.
Give them a head start → hustleup.us
